title: Conditional κ = .003639264106282 (+1.20671216e-7 over #7119): compose ToikY chart-120 pattern
body:

The peer’s original #7115 artifact remains unpublished and is not imported. Credit for the pattern stays with ToikY.

At source cut 39058, public role 962’s rank-seven MOVE is subdivided through chart 120 into ranks four and three. Helper 1447’s rank-eight target becomes two independent rank-four targets. The boundary basis is identity; four unit ADDs implement the middle basis. Total additions: **8 ADDs + 1 net MOVE**. `PROOF.md` gives the concrete arbitrary-input identity and strict concave gain H4+H7−H8−H3.

The complete signed 17-stage deltas are **ΔP={3:+17,4:+17,7:−17}**, **ΔT={4:+34,8:−17}**. The invoice has 110,723 paid positions, 22,257 productive fields, surplus 1,424 and no empty credit. Ordinary work is 777,741,264 <10⁹; fresh precision retains c=2342. The compiler gap changes to 10⁻¹⁸ and H to 172444000000000000000000, with every affected gate recomputed.
